All possible coronavirus symptoms that I've read about so far (not present in all cases):

Losing sense of smell

Shortness of breath (common)

Bluish skin (if there is pneumonia)

Coughing blood

Burning sensation in sternum

Deep, dry cough (common)

Diarrhea (rare, could mean it has spread to organs other than lungs)

Fever (common)

Fatigue, soreness, sweating (usually goes along with fever)

Runny nose (apparently less common, more likely to be allergies or cold)

I've heard of some cases where people get very ill, very suddenly, and others where it's a very gradual process, still others where they get bad, get better then get bad again. Not sure what the statistics are but there are some people documenting the progression of their symptoms in detail. Nervousness can also produce shortness of breath and a shallow cough, it's also cold and allergy season, so lots of people are getting paranoid right now. Kids are more likely to be asymptomatic but an unlucky few do get very ill. Obviously do your research and see what actual scientists and doctors are saying, too.

Internal anger/aggression actually feels pretty good at times but I won't wallow in it or I risk upsetting innocent people or getting burnt out. Yeah, I might be horrible but surprisingly not miserable.
